g.text: DISPLAY STATE LIBRARY / LIVE JUCE TEXT REMAINS SEPARATE
Six reusable LCD modules — clean glass, inset bezel, status rail and reserved dynamic-text field.
Separate off/on/glow/warning/error/success/disabled artwork; state selection is runtime-driven.
12-segment stereo bars, peak hold and clip marker samples — neutral baseline, signal and peak states.
